claim_quarantine: missing claim from or thru date at claim grain
money: exact integer USD cents; negatives preserved; missing never zero
missing_segment_field: one unique nonmissing value may be carried to claim level only after conflict checks
ambiguous_claim_year: use unique nonmissing CLM_THRU_DT solely to assign quarantine impact; unknown/multiple year affects all beneficiaries in question
affected_beneficiary: keep ledger row; nullable complete claim count/payment; excluded from complete-analysis domain; never a true zero
true_zero: no accepted and no potentially qualifying quarantined claim
source_policy: SHA256 pinned official inputs; raw and row-level derivatives excluded from Git
